reason: The componentwise vector-space rules of vl02.tex:91 ('Alle Rechenregeln für Vektorräume gelten auch in den unendlichen dimensionalen Fällen') are correct for all infinite columns and are kept. The defect is the inner product: vl02.tex:91-95 give the series sum_j v_j^* w_j as 'the' inner product of infinite columns, and vl02.tex:96 says that one sets n = infinity 'in allen Gleichungen'. On arbitrary infinite columns this series need not converge (the vector of all ones, vl02.tex:98-107, is the script's own counterexample). v0.2 repairs this a few lines later by introducing l^2; v0.1 does not. The new chapter presents the series as the naive generalisation, shows the counterexample at once (c03.ex.einsen), defines l^2 (D77) and proves that the series converges and the rules hold there (c03.prop.elltwo).

evidence.notes: Diagnosis narrowed to the inner-product series after the second review (docs/review/lectures/REVIEW-lec2.md, row M-0014). Reed-Simon I p. 40 (P-0140) define l_2 with the condition before the inner product. Script v0.3 (2026-10-22, lane ch2, docs/plan/script-v0.3/NOTES-ch2.md): applied: script v0.3 chapter 2 says that setting n = infinity can make the inner product diverge and that the web course admits only columns with a finite sum of squared moduli (sync-ch2.md row 30); no general inner-product series for infinite columns is stated. Destination: the uncommitted working tree registered as tpc-script-v0.3; the commit is still to be made by the coordinator. The v0.1 entries are not application targets.
